title: Animated Theme Switch
subtitle: Switch between light and dark with a transition.
panelClass: flex min-h-[40vh] items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-(--hx-background) p-[3vw] transition-colors duration-500

descriptions.revealAnimation: How the new theme spreads over the old one.
descriptions.duration: How long the theme change takes, in seconds.
descriptions.iconAnimation: How the sun and moon icons swap.
descriptions.showTooltip: Shows a tooltip naming the theme the button switches to.
descriptions.variant: Style of the button: outline, ghost (no border) or filled.

patches: const iconClass = cn("size-10.5 transition-[scale] duration-200 group-hover/button:scale-90", variant !== "default" && "in-data-accent:text-(--hx-primary)")
Tip: The circle
themeDescription: Colour palette. Any theme but Default also tints the sun and moon icon, except on the Default button, which is already primary.
modeDescription: Starting mode; clicking the switch toggles it.
